about_the_game:
Time to quack some ducks (and other targets)!

Need something to do while working or a super boring gaming session?
Add Desk. Target Quacking to your, well, desktop!

Desk. Target Quacking sits on top of your screen so you can still focus on whatever you're doing.
Every now and then a target will appear. Shoot it to gain points.

GAME MODES

Desk. Target Quacking will not only spawn in some targets over time, you can also play one of four game modes:

  • Endless - Targets will appear every few seconds for as long as you want to play

  • Time - Shoot down as many targets as possible within one minute

  • Points - How fast can you get 100 points?

  • Clicker - It's your typical clicker game

Each mode has its own highscore. Keep improving and become the best quacker at the shooting range!

Clicker

Targets spawn super slowly. Boring.
Keep shooting them to earn points. You can spend those hard earned points at the shop to improve the time between target spawns, unlock new ducks and automate the whole process.

How many points will you be able to earn per second?
